def transform(grid):
    # A 3x3 green/blue target stamps a blue cross-shaped key into the matching
    # 3x3 interior region on the opposite side of the blue grid separators.
    # Locate the motif and extend its center-axis cross into blank cells,
    # using blue separator rows/columns as boundaries.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    motif = None
    for r in range(h - 2):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            if all(grid[r+i][c+j] == (2 if (i,j)==(1,1) else 3)
                   for i in range(3) for j in range(3)):
                motif = (r, c)
                break
        if motif: break
    if motif is None: return out
    r, c = motif
    # Continue center vertical/horizontal axes from motif location, filling
    # the reciprocal blank compartment in the grid.
    # Find the other interior cell block delimited by regularly spaced blue lines.
    row_seps = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[i])]
    col_seps = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 2 for i in range(h))]
    # Reproduce demo: motif at top band, output cross in region below horizontal separator;
    # destination has same column center, rows below to boundary and three-row thick center.
    # For arbitrary layouts choose the empty compartment diagonally/opposite motif.
    rbounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    # Determine 3x3 motif block's containing row/column compartments, then find a blank one.
    comps=[]
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        a,b=rbounds[ri]+1,rbounds[ri+1]
        if a<b: 
            for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
                x,y=cbounds[ci]+1,cbounds[ci+1]
                if a<b and x<y: comps.append((a,b,x,y))
    mr, mc = r+1, c+1
    candidates=[q for q in comps if not (q[0]<=mr<q[1] and q[2]<=mc<q[3])]
    # Match nearest compartment with a 3x3 center pattern possible, favor same column.
    dest=min(candidates, key=lambda q: (abs((q[2]+q[3]-1)/2-mc), abs((q[0]+q[1]-1)/2-mr)))
    a,b,x,y=dest
    cr=(a+b-1)//2; cc=(x+y-1)//2
    # Cross motif: central column and central row, with center blue; all other cross cells 1.
    for rr in range(a,b):
        if rr==cr or rr in (cr-1,cr+1):
            for col in range(x,y):
                if col==cc or rr==cr and col in (cc-1,cc+1):
                    out[rr][col]=1
    return out
